packages.name: Lyo.Email
packages.tagline: MailKit SMTP sender. `EmailService` is the `IEmailService` implementation.

packages.name: Lyo.Email.Models
packages.tagline: Shared models, options, failure codes, and event payloads for the `Lyo.Email` SMTP sender.

packages.name: Lyo.Email.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL EF Core store for email mailbox logs (`EmailLogEntity`). The package never sends or fetches mail. Hosts insert outbound rows after SMTP send and inbound rows after their own IMAP/POP client.

packages.name: Lyo.Email.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor workbench that sends mail through an injected `IEmailService`.

packages.name: Lyo.MessageQueue
packages.tagline: `IMqService` defines the queue and exchange contract. Schedulers, workers, and gateways compile against one interface and swap `Lyo.MessageQueue.*` brokers behind it.

packages.name: Lyo.MessageQueue.RabbitMq
packages.tagline: `IMqService` implementation (`RabbitMqService`) on `RabbitMQ.Client`. Also wired as `IRabbitMqService` for exchanges and other RabbitMQ-only methods.

packages.name: Lyo.MessageQueue.RabbitMq.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor UI for RabbitMQ exchanges, bindings, and broker workbenches.

packages.name: Lyo.MessageQueue.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor UI for provider-neutral queue dashboards and workbenches.

packages.name: Lyo.Sms
packages.tagline: Shared SMS contracts and send pipeline. Providers (`Lyo.Sms.Twilio`, and others) implement `SmsServiceBase`.

packages.name: Lyo.Sms.Models
packages.tagline: Shared types used by `Lyo.Sms`: payloads, paging, events, normalization, and base options. The package never sends SMS. Implementations live in provider packages (`Lyo.Sms.Twilio`, and others).

packages.name: Lyo.Sms.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL EF Core store for outbound SMS logs (`SmsLogEntity`). The package never sends SMS. It wires `SmsDbContext` so workers or gateways can store send outcomes.

packages.name: Lyo.Sms.Twilio
packages.tagline: Twilio SMS and MMS via `Lyo.Sms`. `TwilioSmsService` implements `ISmsService`.

packages.name: Lyo.Sms.Twilio.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL EF Core store for Twilio SMS traces: `TwilioSmsDbContext` and `TwilioSmsLogEntity`.

packages.name: Lyo.Sms.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor workbench for an injected `ISmsService`. Uses MudBlazor and snackbar helpers in `Lyo.Web.Components`.

packages.name: Lyo.Stt
packages.tagline: Lyo speech-to-text contract. Ships `ISttService`, `SttServiceBase`, request/result/options/event records, and metric name constants. This repo ships no provider packages.

packages.name: Lyo.Translation
packages.tagline: **Archetype B (capability).** Providers (`Lyo.Translation.Google`, `Lyo.Translation.Aws`) remain under `Communication/Translation/`, not under `Integration/`. See package layout.

packages.name: Lyo.Translation.Aws
packages.tagline: Amazon Translate that implements `ITranslationService`. Translates text, runs bounded bulk translation, infers language via a Translate call, and probes connectivity with `ListLanguages`.

packages.name: Lyo.Translation.Google
packages.tagline: Google Cloud Translation v2 that implements `ITranslationService`. `GoogleTranslationService` extends `TranslationServiceBase` and calls the REST API over HTTP.

packages.name: Lyo.Translation.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor workbench for whichever `Lyo.Translation` implementation the host wired.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts
packages.tagline: TTS contracts and shared behavior: provider-agnostic interfaces, a non-generic facade, and a base service with bulk synthesis, metrics, and lifecycle events.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.AwsPolly
packages.tagline: TTS via Amazon Polly. `AwsPollyTtsService` extends `TtsServiceBase<AwsPollyTtsRequest>` with voice selection, output formats, bulk synthesis, metrics, and DI helpers.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.AwsPolly.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor workbench for exercising `Lyo.Tts.AwsPolly` inside a host app.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.Models
packages.tagline: Shared TTS requests, results, options, and event payloads. Provider packages depend on this package instead of on each other.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.Typecast
packages.tagline: Typecast TTS through `Lyo.Typecast.Client`. `TypecastTtsService` synthesizes audio through `TypecastClient`, can load the voice catalog for validation (`LoadVoicesAsync`), and uses the bulk pipeline plus Typecast-namespaced metrics from `Lyo.Tts`.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.Typecast.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor workbench for exercising `Lyo.Tts.Typecast` inside a host app.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.WindowsSpeech
packages.tagline: Text-to-speech through Windows SAPI. `WindowsSpeechTtsService` uses the built-in Speech API.

packages.name: Lyo.Webhook
packages.tagline: ASP.NET Core inbound webhook verification: headers and raw body, HMAC helpers, `MapWebhook().Verify().Handle()`, and `Lyo.Metrics` timings.

packages.name: Lyo.Webhook.Twilio
packages.tagline: Twilio webhook signature checks for `Lyo.Webhook`. Compares `X-Twilio-Signature` to an HMAC-SHA1 (Base64) of the public request URL plus sorted key+value form parameters.

packages.name: Lyo.Audit
packages.tagline: Audit trail with two records: `AuditChange` (entity change tracking) and `AuditEvent` (events to log).

packages.name: Lyo.Audit.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core persistence for Lyo.Audit in PostgreSQL. Stores `AuditChange` and `AuditEvent` rows with JSONB columns for dictionary data.

packages.name: Lyo.Benchmark
packages.tagline: Helpers used only by `*.Benchmarks` executables. The BenchmarkDotNet counterpart to `Lyo.Testing`.

packages.name: Lyo.Benchmark.Models
packages.tagline: Builders and models for the Lyo benchmark report schema (`lyo.bench/v1`).

packages.name: Lyo.Cache
packages.tagline: In-process `ICacheService` plus typed byte-payload methods. Serialize once, store framed bytes, and optionally compress or encrypt on .NET 10+.

packages.name: Lyo.Cache.Fusion
packages.tagline: `ZiggyCreatures.FusionCache` is adapted to `ICacheService` by `FusionCacheService` so `Lyo.Api`, workers, and feature modules can swap in-memory `Lyo.Cache` for Fusion plus an optional Redis backplane without rewriting call sites.

packages.name: Lyo.ChangeTracker
packages.tagline: Generic entity change history around `Lyo.EntityReference.Models.EntityRef`. Record property-level changes for any entity type without tying the tracker to one aggregate.

packages.name: Lyo.ChangeTracker.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL adapter for `Lyo.ChangeTracker`. Stores entity-scoped change history using `Lyo.EntityReference.Models.EntityRef` for both the target entity and the optional actor.

packages.name: Lyo.Common.Core
packages.tagline: Bottom of the Lyo stack: enums, identifier generators, scalar and string extensions, type conversion, path helpers, secure randomness, and HTTP constants, with no Lyo dependency beyond `Lyo.Exceptions`.

packages.name: Lyo.Common.Json
packages.tagline: `LyoJsonSerializerOptions` — the HTTP JSON contract every Lyo API and first-party client shares — plus opt-in converters for upstreams that quote their scalars.

packages.name: Lyo.Common.Metadata
packages.tagline: Lyo registry records — file type, MIME, language, port, HTTP status, HTTP header, geography, and CLR type catalogs — plus the extensions that bridge enums to those records.

packages.name: Lyo.DateAndTime
packages.tagline: Dates, times, US timezone conversion, day-of-week scheduling, and US holiday metadata. Static and thread-safe. No mutable shared state.

packages.name: Lyo.Diagnostic
packages.tagline: Decode stack traces, classify exceptions, keep breadcrumb trails, hold an in-memory error inbox, sanitise output, and write structured logs.

packages.name: Lyo.Diagnostic.AspNetCore
packages.tagline: ASP.NET Core integration for `Lyo.Diagnostic`. Per-request scoped breadcrumb trails and exception recording to the in-memory error inbox plus structured logging, without replacing existing problem-details middleware.

packages.name: Lyo.Diagnostic.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor (Server / Interactive) workbench that uses `Lyo.Diagnostic` to analyze and triage .NET stack traces and exception payloads.

packages.name: Lyo.Diff
packages.tagline: Compare human-readable text and object graphs side by side.

packages.name: Lyo.EntityReference.Models
packages.tagline: Typed pair of logical entity kind (`EntityType`) and identifier string (`EntityId`), with helpers for composite keys, JSON, opaque tokens, validation, and domain row shapes.

packages.name: Lyo.EntityReference.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core building blocks on PostgreSQL for relation rows (subject/actor associations) and source-link rows (import provenance).

packages.name: Lyo.Exceptions
packages.tagline: Exception types and argument-validation helpers shared by Lyo packages.

packages.name: Lyo.Geolocation
packages.tagline: Geospatial operations and persistence contracts that do not pick a vendor.

packages.name: Lyo.Geolocation.Models
packages.tagline: Vendor-neutral data contracts used by `Lyo.Geolocation` and `Lyo.Geolocation.Postgres`.

packages.name: Lyo.Geolocation.Postgres
packages.tagline: Entity Framework Core persistence of canonical geolocation data in PostgreSQL.

packages.name: Lyo.Health
packages.tagline: Contract for services that report their own health. Implement `IHealth`. There is no central health service.

packages.name: Lyo.Lock
packages.tagline: Exclusive locks by key and keyed semaphores (bounded concurrency per key), plus in-memory implementations for a single process.

packages.name: Lyo.Lock.Redis
packages.tagline: Redis-backed `ILockService` through StackExchange.Redis. Reach for this when several app instances must exclude each other on one logical key.

packages.name: Lyo.Mathematics
packages.tagline: C# contracts for the Lyo math stack: physical quantities as structs, 2D/3D vectors and small matrices, typed inputs/results for formulas, and a small registry so they can be discovered.

packages.name: Lyo.Metrics
packages.tagline: Thread-safe counters, gauges, histograms, timings, errors, and events — in-memory, OpenTelemetry, and null implementations.

packages.name: Lyo.Metrics.DependencyInjection
packages.tagline: Service-collection registration for Lyo.Metrics, split out so the metrics library itself has no NuGet dependencies.

packages.name: Lyo.Metrics.OpenTelemetry
packages.tagline: `IMetrics` implementation that exports through OpenTelemetry to OpenTelemetry-compatible backends.

packages.name: Lyo.Metrics.Statistics
packages.tagline: Histogram statistics on top of `Lyo.Metrics`: percentile, quartile, moving-average, and anomaly-detection helpers.

packages.name: Lyo.Notification
packages.tagline: Small domain events via in-process publish/subscribe. Not distributed, not durable, and not ordered across machines. Only useful when every publisher and handler lives in the same process.

packages.name: Lyo.PackageMetadata
packages.tagline: `PackageMetadata` rows across ecosystems, `PackageMetadataRegistration`, `IPackageMetadataStore`, and `PackageArtifactDigest` helpers that correlate stack-trace namespaces with persisted catalog data.

packages.name: Lyo.PackageMetadata.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core store behind `Lyo.PackageMetadata.IPackageMetadataStore`.

packages.name: Lyo.Parameters
packages.tagline: Keyed parameter contracts and the parameter-definition model shared by jobs, reports, and query templates.

packages.name: Lyo.People.Models
packages.tagline: People-domain records: `Person`, contact, employment, identification, and relationships.

packages.name: Lyo.People.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core persistence of Lyo.People.Models in PostgreSQL.

packages.name: Lyo.Privacy
packages.tagline: Masks emails, phones, Luhn card numbers, IBAN, secrets, IDs, URLs, IPs, and street lines in free text, JSON, and XML.

packages.name: Lyo.Privacy.AspNetCore
packages.tagline: DI wiring for `Lyo.Privacy` on ASP.NET Core: registers `ITextRedactor` / `IStructuredRedactor`, binds `PrivacyRedactorOptions` from configuration, and allows keyed per-tenant or per-feature…

packages.name: Lyo.Privacy.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor (Server / Interactive) workbench components for `Lyo.Privacy`. Operators can preview, compare, and tune redaction policies without a host config round-trip.

packages.name: Lyo.Resilience
packages.tagline: Thin Polly wrapper for resilience pipelines, with appsettings binding and built-in logging.

packages.name: Lyo.Result
packages.tagline: `Result` / `Result<T>` with `Error` graphs, builders, bulk/paged envelopes, and `Task` composition. Distinct from `Lyo.Common.Core` `Result`.

packages.name: Lyo.Schedule.Models
packages.tagline: Schedule-only DTOs. `Lyo.Scheduler`, `Lyo.Job.Postgres`, and other callers use this when they need a transport-friendly answer to "when does this run".

packages.name: Lyo.Schedule.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor component(s) for interactively building and previewing `Lyo.Schedule.Models.ScheduleDefinition` values.

packages.name: Lyo.Scheduler
packages.tagline: In-process scheduler that runs actions at scheduled times. Supports **SetTimes**, **Interval**, **OneShot**, and **Cron** schedules (5- or 6-field expressions) with logging, metrics, and…

packages.name: Lyo.Scheduler.Cache
packages.tagline: Cache-backed `ISchedulerStateStore` for `Lyo.Scheduler`. Writes each schedule's `LastRunUtc` / `NextRunUtc` / state markers through `Lyo.Cache` so cron/interval/one-shot schedules survive process…

packages.name: Lyo.Scientific
packages.tagline: Scientific domain models, reference datasets, SI-oriented unit helpers, and formula discovery on top of `Lyo.Mathematics`.

packages.name: Lyo.Streams
packages.tagline: `TeeStream`, `CountingStream`, `ProgressStream`, `ConcatenatedStream`, and related wrappers. Incremental hashing lives in `Lyo.Hashing` (`HashingStream`).

packages.name: Lyo.SystemInformation
packages.tagline: Inventory of the host machine — hardware, software, drives, network interfaces, and monitors (including EDID parsing) — plus structured logging of that snapshot.

packages.name: Lyo.Testing
packages.tagline: Helpers for xUnit v3: fluent `Should*` asserts, exception and collection helpers, polling checks, and a logger backed by `ITestOutputHelper`.

packages.name: Lyo.Testing.Containers
packages.tagline: Testcontainers fixtures for xUnit v3 covering Redis, RabbitMQ, and PostgreSQL, plus a DI-wired Postgres service fixture.

packages.name: Lyo.TextEncoding
packages.tagline: Binary codecs (Base64 / Base64Url / Hex) plus charset encode/decode/convert with CodePages, detection, PEM/MIME, and injectable services.

packages.name: Lyo.Validation
packages.tagline: C# validators, fluent rule builders, validation attributes, and `WhereClause` schemas that surface failures as `Lyo.Result.Result<T>`.

packages.name: Lyo.Validation.Models
packages.tagline: Contracts for validation plus the data-driven rule model: schemas, rules, messages, and projecting a where-clause into `Error`.

packages.name: Lyo.Validation.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL store for `ValidationSchema` documents (WhereClause JSONB) behind `IValidationSchemaStore`.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Primitives
packages.tagline: Shared MudBlazor UI primitives for every Lyo component package, with no query, data-grid, or API dependencies.

packages.name: Lyo.Barcode
packages.tagline: Contracts for generating and decoding barcodes: IBarcodeService, request and options models, plus BarcodeBuilder.

packages.name: Lyo.Barcode.Native
packages.tagline: Lyo.Barcode `IBarcodeService` with no third-party barcode generator.

packages.name: Lyo.Barcode.TestWorkbench.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor page that puts <BarcodeWorkbench /> from Lyo.Barcode.Web.Components in a MudContainer for the Lyo gateway test harness.

packages.name: Lyo.Barcode.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor UI that talks to Lyo.Barcode's IBarcodeService.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression
packages.tagline: Compress and decompress bytes, strings, streams, and files with ICompressionService. One default codec, plus ICompressionResolver for per-algorithm dispatch.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.BZip2
packages.tagline: Addon that plugs BZip2 into `Lyo.Compression` by registering a BZip2 `ICompressorFactory`.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.Lz4
packages.tagline: `Lyo.Compression` addon that registers an `LZ4` `ICompressorFactory` using `EasyCompressor.LZ4`.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.Lzma
packages.tagline: LZMA plugin for `Lyo.Compression` that registers an LZMA `ICompressorFactory`.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.Snappier
packages.tagline: Snappy support for `Lyo.Compression` via a Snappier `ICompressorFactory`.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.Xz
packages.tagline: XZ / LZMA2 support for `Lyo.Compression` through an XZ `ICompressorFactory`.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.Zstd
packages.tagline: Zstandard addon for `Lyo.Compression` that registers a Zstd `ICompressorFactory`.

packages.name: Lyo.Csv
packages.tagline: In-house CSV stack for Lyo.Csv.Models. CsvService composes a CsvWriter and CsvReader over an internal tokenizer/writer with typed binders. No third-party CSV library.

packages.name: Lyo.Csv.Models
packages.tagline: CSV stack contracts and value types. Depend on ICsvService, ICsvReader, and ICsvWriter here; Lyo.Csv is the implementation package.

packages.name: Lyo.DataTable
packages.tagline: Placeholder package that holds the `Lyo.DataTable` name only. Runtime types (`DataTable`, `DataTableRow`, `DataTableBuilder`, cell types, HTML renderer) ship in `Lyo.DataTable.Models`.

packages.name: Lyo.DataTable.Models
packages.tagline: In-memory mutable table: sparse columns, thin cells, optional format map, fluent builders, HTML renderer.

packages.name: Lyo.FFmpeg
packages.tagline: CliWrap wrapper around ffmpeg, ffprobe, and ffplay for convert, play, and stream of audio and video.

packages.name: Lyo.FFmpeg.Models
packages.tagline: FFmpeg host options and command-line model for Lyo.FFmpeg.

packages.name: Lyo.FileMetadataStore
packages.tagline: File identity without the bytes. Canonical Guid identifiers and metadata, not blob I/O.

packages.name: Lyo.FileMetadataStore.Postgres
packages.tagline: Postgres IFileMetadataStore plus the adjunct stores richer file pipelines use.

packages.name: Lyo.FileMetadataStore.Sqlite
packages.tagline: EF Core SQLite IFileMetadataStore. Same store and adjunct services as Lyo.FileMetadataStore.Postgres, for embedded, offline-first, and local-dev hosts.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage
packages.tagline: Save, stream-save, read, delete, and file metadata. Optional compression (Lyo.Compression), two-key encryption (Lyo.Encryption), duplicate hashing, access policies, audit hooks, multipart (IMultipartUploadService), and presigned/direct-upload/copy on cloud backends.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage.AzureBlob
packages.tagline: Azure.Storage.Blobs IFileStorageService for Azure Blob Storage.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage.Ftp
packages.tagline: `IFileStorageService` on FTP through Lyo.Ftp.Client.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage.S3
packages.tagline: Lyo.FileStorage on S3-compatible endpoints (AWS S3, Backblaze B2, MinIO, and others) through AWSSDK.S3.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage.Sftp
packages.tagline: `IFileStorageService` on SFTP through Lyo.Sftp.Client.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor Server / Interactive UI for Lyo.FileStorage. Trees, grids, and dialogs for file metadata, expected storage keys, download access links, and DEK migrate/rotate.

packages.name: Lyo.FileSystemWatcher
packages.tagline: Snapshot-based .NET file watcher. Finds creates, deletes, changes, moves, and renames with debounce and SHA256 hashing.

packages.name: Lyo.FileSystemWatcher.Models
packages.tagline: Persistable file-system snapshot, change, and watch-options DTOs, plus DTO-native change detection.

packages.name: Lyo.FileSystemWatcher.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL store for FileSystemWatcher snapshots and change events. Service layer only — no HTTP.

packages.name: Lyo.Formatter
packages.tagline: SmartFormat.NET templates plus C#-like `{...}` expressions (DateTime, ternary, in-memory LINQ) for user-defined strings.

packages.name: Lyo.Formatter.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor pair for live SmartFormat editing: a debounced template box and an annotated preview that color-links `{keys}` to replacements. Runs on WASM.

packages.name: Lyo.Ftp.Client
packages.tagline: FluentFTP client with a connection pool, PathHelpers jail, logging, and Lyo.Metrics. Prefer `*Async`.

packages.name: Lyo.IO.FileSystem
packages.tagline: Path-rooted virtual file system: one contract for local disk, memory, SFTP, FTP, S3, and Azure Blob.

packages.name: Lyo.IO.Temp
packages.tagline: Session-scoped temp files and directories, with naming strategies and overflow policies.

packages.name: Lyo.Images
packages.tagline: SixLabors.ImageSharp raster processing for .NET.

packages.name: Lyo.Images.Ocr
packages.tagline: Lyo OCR contracts: `IOcrEngine`, request/response models, Y-up pixel boxes (same as `BoundingBox2D`), coordinate helpers, and shared options.

packages.name: Lyo.Images.Ocr.Tesseract
packages.tagline: Tesseract `IOcrEngine` for `Lyo.Images.Ocr`. An internal lock serializes calls because native Tesseract instances are not safely concurrent.

packages.name: Lyo.Images.OpenCv
packages.tagline: OpenCvSharp4 helpers for .NET. Split from higher-level pipelines (e.g. comic overlay) so hosts take native OpenCV only where they need it.

packages.name: Lyo.Images.Skia
packages.tagline: SkiaSharp `IImageService` for `Lyo.Images`: resize, crop, rotate, watermark, convert, thumbnails, compression, metadata, palette, batch.

packages.name: Lyo.Images.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor workbenches for `Lyo.Images`: `IImageService` tools plus a spritesheet animator/extractor on `ISpriteSheetExportService`.

packages.name: Lyo.Media.Models
packages.tagline: Sibling IAudio* and IVideo* contracts, encoder catalogs, and conversion/play/probe records. Images stay IImageService.

packages.name: Lyo.Pdf
packages.tagline: Read with PdfPig and edit with PDFsharp for `Lyo.Pdf.Models`. Start at `PdfService`: disposable `IPdfReader` for extract work, `IPdfWriter` for structural edits.

packages.name: Lyo.Pdf.Models
packages.tagline: PDF stack contracts and value types. Depend on `IPdfService`, `IPdfReader`, `IPdfWriter`, and `ITextExtractor` here; `Lyo.Pdf` is the PdfPig/PDFsharp implementation.

packages.name: Lyo.Pdf.Ocr
packages.tagline: PNG-renders a PDF page with `Lyo.Pdf.Rendering`, runs `IOcrEngine`, then lifts OCR pixel boxes into PDF points.

packages.name: Lyo.Pdf.Rendering
packages.tagline: Turns PDF pages into PNG through PDFtoImage (PDFium + Skia; `bblanchon.PDFium` native packages). Targets `net10.0`.

packages.name: Lyo.Pdf.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor PDF workbenches: HTML to PDF, annotation, and `LyoPdfAnnotator` so drawn regions emit `PdfBoundingBox`.

packages.name: Lyo.Postgres
packages.tagline: Shared PostgreSQL host bits for Lyo libraries that own an EF Core schema (Audit, Email, ChangeTracker, EntityReference, etc.): migrations, schema/option building, design-time factories, and health checks.

packages.name: Lyo.QRCode
packages.tagline: Generate and read QR codes: `IQRCodeService`, `QRCodeBuilder`, in-box ISO Model 2 encoding (`BuiltInQRCodeService`), optional QRCoder adapter.

packages.name: Lyo.QRCode.QRCoder
packages.tagline: `IQRCodeService` from `Lyo.QRCode` implemented with QRCoder. Pick this for JPEG / Bitmap on Windows, or for QRCoder's renderers.

packages.name: Lyo.QRCode.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor UI that generates and previews QR codes.

packages.name: Lyo.Query
packages.tagline: Turn a WhereClause AST into LINQ on IQueryable: filter, multi-key sort, in-memory match/explain, with ICache-backed compiled predicates.

packages.name: Lyo.Query.Evaluation
packages.tagline: Evaluate where clauses without a cache: build expressions, match in memory, explain matches, and resolve property paths.

packages.name: Lyo.Query.Models
packages.tagline: Filter / sort / projection DTOs and fluent builders (`WhereClause`, QueryConcrete / QueryProject / root Query) that Lyo.Query and Lyo.Api share.

packages.name: Lyo.Query.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor UI that edits and runs `Lyo.Query.Models` requests against any Lyo.Api host.

packages.name: Lyo.Seed
packages.tagline: Seeder that does not care how items are built: contributors yield them, then EF or Lyo.Api bulk-create writes them.

packages.name: Lyo.Sftp.Client
packages.tagline: SSH.NET SFTP client with a connection pool, PathHelpers jail, logging, and Lyo.Metrics. Prefer `*Async`.

packages.name: Lyo.Sqlite
packages.tagline: Common SQLite migration host bits for Lyo libraries that own an EF Core schema.

packages.name: Lyo.Xlsx
packages.tagline: `Lyo.Xlsx.Models` implementation. `XlsxService` composes an `XlsxWriter` (streaming `DocumentFormat.OpenXml`) and an `XlsxReader` (ExcelDataReader / ClosedXML).

packages.name: Lyo.Xlsx.Models
packages.tagline: XLSX stack contracts and value types. Depend on `IXlsxService` / `IXlsxReader` / `IXlsxWriter` here; `Lyo.Xlsx` is the ClosedXML implementation.

packages.name: Lyo.Comic
packages.tagline: Domain contracts for a serialized fiction catalog: series (`ComicSeries`, `ComicAlternateTitle`), hierarchy (`ComicVolume`, `ComicChapter`, `ComicPage`), cast (`ComicCharacter`), `ComicSeriesQuery`, `ComicType`/`ComicStatus`, and `IComicStore`.

packages.name: Lyo.Comic.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL and EF Core implementation of `Lyo.Comic.IComicStore` (`PostgresComicStore`) via `ComicDbContext` and `PostgresComicOptions`.

packages.name: Lyo.Comic.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor components for browsing, previewing, and reading comic series. Search panel, result grids and lists, browse cards, and a MangaFire-style tap-to-navigate reader.

packages.name: Lyo.Comment
packages.tagline: Contracts for threaded, reactable comments on any entity. Each comment has a **subject**, an **actor**, optional `ReplyToCommentId`, and cached like/dislike counters.

packages.name: Lyo.Comment.Postgres
packages.tagline: Entity Framework Core store for `Lyo.Comment` on PostgreSQL. Comments live in `comment.comment` and reactions in `comment.comment_reaction`.

packages.name: Lyo.Config
packages.tagline: Typed, definition-driven configuration for per-entity values (a Discord guild, a tenant). The abstract API lives here. PostgreSQL persistence is in `Lyo.Config.Postgres`.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL and EF Core implementation of `Lyo.Config.IConfigStore` for typed configuration definitions and per-entity bindings.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor dashboard for Lyo.Config. Add ConfigManagement to a host page for definitions, resolved bindings, and two first-class histories against IConfigStore.

packages.name: Lyo.ContactUs
packages.tagline: Contact-form submission contracts. `IContactUsService` and `ContactUsServiceBase` cover validation, error-code mapping, and logging. Storage sits in sibling packages.

packages.name: Lyo.ContactUs.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL and EF Core implementation of `Lyo.ContactUs.IContactUsService` (`PostgresContactUsService`) through `ContactUsDbContext` and `PostgresContactUsOptions`.

packages.name: Lyo.Favorite
packages.tagline: Contracts for "X favorited Y" ties between any two entities. The boundary takes `EntityRef`.

packages.name: Lyo.Favorite.Postgres
packages.tagline: Entity Framework Core store for `Lyo.Favorite` on PostgreSQL. Rows live in `favorite.favorite` (`PostgresFavoriteOptions.Schema = "favorite"`).

packages.name: Lyo.HomeInventory
packages.tagline: Contract for household inventory: large purchases (electronics, appliances) with warranty tracking, kitchen consumables across pantries / freezers, and garage bin locations.

packages.name: Lyo.HomeInventory.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core implementation of `IHomeInventoryStore` backed by PostgreSQL.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Models
packages.tagline: Shared DTOs, builders, enums, metrics constants, distributed-tracing helpers, and message-queue contracts for Lyo job management.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL persistence for Lyo job management.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor dashboard for the Lyo job stack. Drop `JobManagement` on a host page for Statistics, Definitions, Schedules, Runs (progress and SLA breach), worker registry, and workflow views.

packages.name: Lyo.Note
packages.tagline: Contracts for notes hung on entities. A note has a **subject** (what it is about) and an **actor** (who wrote it), both as `EntityRef`.

packages.name: Lyo.Note.Postgres
packages.tagline: Entity Framework Core store for `Lyo.Note` on PostgreSQL. Rows live in `note.note` (`PostgresNoteOptions.Schema = "note"`), and the package includes migrations.

packages.name: Lyo.Profanity
packages.tagline: File-based profanity filter. Finds and replaces profane words. Several languages, regex patterns, plain word lists, and configurable replacement strategies.

packages.name: Lyo.Rating
packages.tagline: Contracts for rating and reviewing entities, plus like/dislike reactions on those ratings.

packages.name: Lyo.Rating.Postgres
packages.tagline: Entity Framework Core store for `Lyo.Rating` on PostgreSQL. Ratings live in `rating.rating` and reactions in `rating.rating_reaction`.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Models
packages.tagline: Lyo Reporting composition models, fluent builders, API contracts, and generation hooks.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL schema (`reporting`), EF migrations, CSV/XLSX/JSON renderers, the `ReportService` generation pipeline, and `ReportRetentionService` cleanup.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Web
packages.tagline: Blazor `ReportViewer` plus `IReportRenderer` producing HTML and PDF.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor ops UI for Lyo Reporting: browse definitions, run reports, design compositions, and view or download generations.

packages.name: Lyo.ShortUrl
packages.tagline: URL-shortening contracts: `IShortUrlService`, `ShortUrlServiceBase` for validation / metrics / error-code mapping, a default `ShortUrlService` that mints short codes (no storage), `UrlShortenBuilder`, and DTOs for shorten / expand / statistics.

packages.name: Lyo.ShortUrl.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core schema and DbContext registration for a PostgreSQL-backed short-URL store.

packages.name: Lyo.Tag
packages.tagline: Contracts for hanging tags on entities. The target is an `EntityRef`, and the person or system that applied the tag is an optional second `EntityRef`.

packages.name: Lyo.Tag.Postgres
packages.tagline: Entity Framework Core store for `Lyo.Tag` on PostgreSQL. Rows live in `tag.tag` (`PostgresTagOptions.Schema = "tag"`), and the package includes migrations.

packages.name: Lyo.Discord.Bot
packages.tagline: Library (not an executable) that runs a DSharpPlus Discord bot and upserts guild data into your Lyo API (`Lyo.Discord.Client` against PostgreSQL-backed `Discord/*` endpoints).

packages.name: Lyo.Discord.Client
packages.tagline: Typed HTTP client for the Discord REST endpoints `Lyo.Api` exposes (the `Discord/*` group registered by `Lyo.Discord.Postgres`).

packages.name: Lyo.Discord.Models
packages.tagline: Wire-level DTOs and shared constants for the Discord integration. `Lyo.Discord.Client` (typed HTTP client) and `Lyo.Discord.Postgres` (API host + persistence) both use these so request and response shapes stay aligned.

packages.name: Lyo.Discord.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL persistence plus `Lyo.Api` endpoint mappings for Discord entities. Schema name is locked to `discord` (`PostgresDiscordOptions.Schema`).

packages.name: Lyo.Endato.Client
packages.tagline: Typed HTTP client for Endato's data-enrichment REST API.

packages.name: Lyo.Endato.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core context and PostgreSQL schema that cache Endato Person Search (PS) and Contact Enrichment (CE) responses. Schema name is `endato`.

packages.name: Lyo.Endato.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor workbench UI for Endato person search and enrichment.

packages.name: Lyo.Espn.Fantasy.Football.Client
packages.tagline: Read-only typed client for ESPN's fantasy football v3 API (`lm-api-reads.fantasy.espn.com/apis/v3/games/ffl/`).

packages.name: Lyo.Google.Geolocation.Client
packages.tagline: REST client for Google Maps plus an `IGeolocationService` implementation.

packages.name: Lyo.Typecast.Client
packages.tagline: HTTP client for Typecast TTS and voice catalog work. `TypecastClient` subclasses `Lyo.Api.Client.ApiClient`, sets `X-API-KEY` from `TypecastClientOptions`, and surfaces two…

packages.name: Lyo.Api
packages.tagline: Minimal-API library that maps EF Core entities onto REST CRUD. `ApiEndpointBuilder` emits Query, Get, Create, Update, Patch, Delete, Upsert, bulk variants, and optional export.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Authentication
packages.tagline: Administrative HTTP endpoints for Lyo Authentication. Postgres stores stay in `Lyo.Authentication.Postgres`. `BuildAuthenticationApi` lives here.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Client
packages.tagline: Lyo API HTTP client: problem-details (`ApiException`), `ApiRouteBuilder`, Query/QueryProject, correlation. Generic JSON verbs live on `Lyo.Http.Client`.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Export
packages.tagline: Optional export add-on for Lyo.Api. Registers the Export CRUD endpoint and `IExportService<TContext>`.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Export.Csv
packages.tagline: CSV format handler for Lyo.Api export.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Export.Xlsx
packages.tagline: XLSX format handler for Lyo.Api export.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.FileStorage
packages.tagline: HTTP endpoints for Lyo file storage. Hosts map BuildFileStorageApi after a keyed IFileStorageService stack is registered.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.FileStorage.Models
packages.tagline: Request and response DTOs for the file-storage HTTP API. This package does not depend on Lyo.FileStorage.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Models
packages.tagline: HTTP contract models shared by Lyo minimal APIs and their clients. Distinct from `Lyo.Query.Models` (projection DTOs + filter trees).

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Tests.Host
packages.tagline: Reference ASP.NET Core minimal-API host that `Lyo.Api.Tests` and other integration tests target via `WebApplicationFactory<Program>`.

packages.name: Lyo.Comic.Api
packages.tagline: HTTP mapping for the Lyo Comic API (`BuildComicGroup`).

packages.name: Lyo.Comic.Api.Host
packages.tagline: Standalone ASP.NET host for the Lyo Comic API.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Api
packages.tagline: HTTP host for central app configuration, backed by PostgreSQL and `Lyo.Config`.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Api.Client
packages.tagline: HTTP client typed for `Lyo.Config.Api`. Conditional app-config reads with `?version` / `If-None-Match` polling, optional `X-Api-Key`, HTTP `IConfigStore` (`ConfigApiStore`) over manage routes, and DI extensions.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Api.Host
packages.tagline: ASP.NET host that runs `Lyo.Config.Api` on its own.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Api.Hosting
packages.tagline: Connects `IConfigApiClient` (`Lyo.Config.Api.Client`) to `Microsoft.Extensions.Options` and `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection`. A `BackgroundService` polls a shared `ResolvedConfigRecord` ledger.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Api.Models
packages.tagline: Config HTTP API contracts: `ConfigResolveOutcome`, `ConfigResolveConditionalResult`, and `HttpStatusDescriptor`.

packages.name: Lyo.Drift.Agent
packages.tagline: Watches configured directories and posts file-tree and system-info snapshots to the Drift collector.

packages.name: Lyo.Drift.Api
packages.tagline: HTTP mapping for the Lyo Drift collector API (`BuildDriftGroup`).

packages.name: Lyo.Drift.Api.Host
packages.tagline: Standalone ASP.NET host for the Lyo Drift collector API.

packages.name: Lyo.Drift.Client
packages.tagline: HTTP client for the Lyo Drift collector API.

packages.name: Lyo.HomeInventory.Api
packages.tagline: HTTP mapping for the Lyo HomeInventory API (`BuildHomeInventoryGroup`).

packages.name: Lyo.HomeInventory.Api.Host
packages.tagline: Standalone ASP.NET host for the Lyo HomeInventory API.

packages.name: Lyo.Http.Client
packages.tagline: Generic HTTP client: IHttpClientFactory, JSON verbs, serializable plans, AngleSharp extract, rate limiting, cookies, and opt-in timing/UA rotation.

packages.name: Lyo.Http.Client.Flared
packages.tagline: FlareSolverr adapter for Lyo.Http.Client: ThroughSolver HTML/JSON, cookie+UA streaming downloads, PerSession UA pin. Educational/personal use.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Alerts
packages.tagline: Hosted `JobAlertConsumer` that binds the `job.notifications.alert` routing key on the `job.events` exchange, deserializes `JobAlertEvent` payloads, and sends them through `INotificationPublisher` and/or an optional HTTP webhook.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Api
packages.tagline: HTTP mapping for the Lyo Job API (`BuildJobGroup`).

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Api.Host
packages.tagline: Standalone ASP.NET host for the Lyo Job API.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Client
packages.tagline: Typed HTTP client for the Lyo Job API. Wraps `IApiClient` and exposes run-lifecycle methods (`StartAsync`, `LogAsync`, `FinishAsync`, `RequeueAsync`) plus worker-instance endpoints from `Lyo.Job.Models.Constants.Rest.Job`.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Scheduler
packages.tagline: A hosted `JobScheduler` polls the Job API for enabled definitions, evaluates schedules (blackout calendars, misfire catch-up, per-schedule time zones), and creates job runs via `IApiClient`.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Worker
packages.tagline: Lyo job-system worker SDK. Subclass `JobWorkerBase` and implement `ExecuteAsync(IJobWorkerContext)`. The base class consumes the priority-enabled worker-type queue.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Api
packages.tagline: Authenticated HTTP endpoints for Lyo Reporting. Postgres stays service-only (`ReportService` + EF). `BuildReportingGroup` lives in this package.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Api.Host
packages.tagline: Standalone ASP.NET host for the Lyo Reporting API.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Client
packages.tagline: Typed HTTP client targeting the Lyo Reporting API (`netstandard2.0;net10.0`).

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Automation
packages.tagline: Browser-automation models shared across runners: locators, JSON plans, a session abstraction, and plan execution. Playwright and Selenium types stay out of this package.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Automation.Playwright
packages.tagline: Playwright backend for the `Lyo.Web.Automation` abstractions: launches Chromium / Firefox / WebKit, owns session-scoped browser contexts, and matches the Selenium helpers.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Automation.Selenium
packages.tagline: Selenium WebDriver backend for the `Lyo.Web.Automation` abstractions: launch Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari (plus Selenium Grid), isolate sessions, and cover polling, tabs, frames, and plans.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor / Blazor pieces for Lyo web UI: data grid, query builder, change-tracking form, file upload, rich-text editor, JSON editor, text-diff viewer, and identifier workbench.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Components.Export
packages.tagline: Menu items that export from Lyo data grids. Reference this package (and any optional format packages) and drop items into `BulkExportControls`.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Components.Export.Csv
packages.tagline: CSV export menu item for Lyo data grids.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Components.Export.Xlsx
packages.tagline: XLSX export menu item for Lyo data grids.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Host
packages.tagline: Shared Blazor host shell so a second app does not have to copy TestGateway's layout, theme, and client DI.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.WebRenderer
packages.tagline: Server-side Razor rendering and HTML→PDF conversion. Razor rendering uses `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.HtmlRenderer`; PDF conversion is driven by **PuppeteerSharp** against a…

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication
packages.tagline: Server-side authentication services for Lyo. Two coexisting bearer formats behind a single contract.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.AspNetCore
packages.tagline: ASP.NET Core integration for `Lyo.Authentication`. Three schemes coexist behind a single dispatcher.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Client
packages.tagline: Consumer-side runtime for the Lyo BFF auth flow. Plugs a web host, typically a Blazor Server gateway or a server-rendered API consumer, into a Lyo authentication API without ever exposing tokens to the browser.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Google
packages.tagline: Google profile for `Lyo.Authentication.OpenIdConnect`. Registers `https://accounts.google.com` as a confidential OIDC client in the BFF login flow.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Keycloak
packages.tagline: Keycloak profile for `Lyo.Authentication.OpenIdConnect`. Wires one or more Keycloak realms as confidential OIDC clients in the BFF login flow.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Models
packages.tagline: Wire-shape data for `Lyo.Authentication`. The half of the auth stack that's safe to ship to anyone, including Blazor WebAssembly clients.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.OpenIdConnect
packages.tagline: OpenID Connect client base for Lyo. The Lyo API is the OIDC confidential client (BFF pattern). The frontend never sees the IdP and never receives tokens by URL fragment.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL persistence for `Lyo.Authentication`. Replaces the in-memory stores from the base lib with EF Core-backed implementations of `IApiTokenStore`, `IUserStore`, `IExternalIdentityStore`, `IUserClaimStore`, and `IUserScopeStore`.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Host-agnostic Razor / MudBlazor components for Lyo authentication. Ships Login, Profile, Tokens, Auth Debug, and the AuthAdminPanel plus the abstractions that the Server and Wasm host adapters implement.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Web.Components.Server
packages.tagline: Blazor Server host adapter for `Lyo.Authentication.Web.Components`. Plugs the shared login / debug / profile pages into the BFF-cookie auth runtime in `Lyo.Authentication.Client`.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Web.Components.Wasm
packages.tagline: Blazor WebAssembly host adapter for `Lyo.Authentication.Web.Components`. Implements the same login / debug / profile pages over a pure-browser auth flow. No consumer-side server, no HttpOnly cookie.

packages.name: Lyo.ContentThreatScan
packages.tagline: Heuristic scanning and numeric disposition scoring for readable text payloads: scripts, markup, suspicious SQL-ish patterns.

packages.name: Lyo.ContentThreatScan.Intel
packages.tagline: Optional `DefaultContentThreatReputationPipeline` for Malware Bazaar, VirusTotal, and `clamd` INSTREAM (TCP).

packages.name: Lyo.Drift.Models
packages.tagline: DTOs, enums, and route constants for the Lyo Drift collector: instances, structure snapshots, and diffs.

packages.name: Lyo.Drift.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL persistence for the Lyo Drift collector.

packages.name: Lyo.Drift.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor workbench for Drift collector instances, snapshots, diffs, and live changes.

packages.name: Lyo.Encryption
packages.tagline: Authenticated encryption for .NET. AEAD, RSA hybrids, and envelope (two-key) flows with optional Lyo.KeyStore lookup.

packages.name: Lyo.Encryption.AesCcm
packages.tagline: AES-CCM authenticated encryption addon for `Lyo.Encryption`. Provides `AesCcmEncryptionService` (BouncyCastle-backed on all targets) and matching DI extensions.

packages.name: Lyo.Encryption.AesSiv
packages.tagline: AES-SIV (RFC 5297) deterministic authenticated encryption addon for `Lyo.Encryption`. Provides `AesSivEncryptionService` backed by `Dorssel.Security.Cryptography.AesExtra` and matching DI extensions.

packages.name: Lyo.Encryption.XChaCha20Poly1305
packages.tagline: XChaCha20-Poly1305 (24-byte nonce, 32-byte key) authenticated-encryption addon for `Lyo.Encryption`.

packages.name: Lyo.Hashing
packages.tagline: Digests (SHA-256/384/512), optional MD5 for non-security fingerprints only, non-cryptographic checksums (CRC-32/CRC-32C/CRC-64/Adler-32), hexadecimal encoding (`HexEncoding`), incremental hashing (`HashingStream`), sparse file fingerprints (`SparseFileFingerprinter`), and injectable `IHashingService` / `HashingService`.

packages.name: Lyo.KeyStore
packages.tagline: Key encryption key (KEK) storage and rotation contracts for `Lyo.Encryption`.

packages.name: Lyo.KeyStore.Aws
packages.tagline: `AwsKeyStore` takes an `IAmazonSecretsManager` client and a secret-name prefix. It implements `Lyo.KeyStore.IKeyStore` and `Lyo.KeyStore.IKeyInventoryStore`, so admin UIs and key-rotation jobs can encrypt against it and list `keyId`s and versions.

packages.name: Lyo.KeyStore.Web.Components
packages.tagline: In-process Blazor workbench for IKeyStore. Lists key ids and versions, adds from a string, rotates, and sets current. No HTTP, no raw key bytes.

packages.name: Lyo.Drift.Agent.Example
packages.tagline: Sample Drift agent host.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Scheduler.Example
packages.tagline: Sample job scheduler host.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Worker.Example
packages.tagline: Sample job worker that subscribes to job.run.example.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Business.Example
packages.tagline: Sample reporting host that wires Lyo.Reporting into a small Blazor app.

packages.name: Lyo.Cli
packages.tagline: Installable `lyo` CLI that covers encryption, encoding, compression, hashing, IDs, query build/exec, and CSV/XLSX.

packages.name: Lyo.TestApi
packages.tagline: Minimal-API host backing `Lyo.TestGateway` and `Lyo.TestConsole`. Wires Lyo Postgres stores, the RabbitMQ job system, S3 file storage with two-key encryption, and the file-storage workbench endpoints.

packages.name: Lyo.TestConsole
packages.tagline: Scratch host used to exercise Lyo services from a long-lived `Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting` process.

packages.name: Lyo.TestGateway
packages.tagline: Blazor Server workbench for the Lyo platform. About 30 routed test pages (cache, locks, file storage, PDF, and more) plus a thin proxy so each page can hit a remote API or in-process services.

packages.name: Lyo.Tools.Postgres
packages.tagline: Spectre.Console TUI used for EF Core migrations against Lyo Postgres `DbContext`s, plus `Lyo.Seed` contributors (EF direct and Lyo.Api bulk).

packages.name: Lyo.IO.FileSystem.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor folder tree over `IFileTreeSource` (local `IFileSystem` or HTTP).
